content.short: Ingonmaya delivers GPU-optimized ICICLE tools to advance ZKP hardware acceleration.
content.description: Ingonmaya is a semiconductor-focused initiative dedicated to accelerating zero-knowledge proofs through specialized hardware. By adopting a multidisciplinary approach and building on deep ZK knowledge, it seeks to identify and overcome the computational challenges inherent to ZKPs. The project serves as a resource for ZK developers and researchers, helping them push the limits of zero-knowledge proofs by advancing GPU-driven acceleration and related hardware innovations, with scalable tooling for practical deployment.
content.meta: Ingonmaya focuses on zero-knowledge-proof hardware acceleration with GPU-optimized ICICLE tooling. Discover Ingonmaya and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
